mission: red-team provenance integrity: prove the integrity audit tooling (e24/d2-09) catches append-only violations, records referencing nonexistent media, sha mismatches, and held-out contamination; fix every miss and pin it as a regression test

method.sandbox: every attack is applied to a hardlink sandbox copy of datasets/ under a temp dir (datasets/experiments real-copied so audit report writes never touch repo inodes); the audit under test runs inside the sandbox with --no-urls; new issues vs a clean-sandbox baseline are matched against the attack's expect clause; sandboxes are deleted afterwards — no corrupted data was ever committed or left in the working tree
method.attackCorpus: datasets/experiments/wave-f/f24-attack-fixtures.json (15 attacks: 3 append-only edits/deletes, 4 held-out contaminations incl. a label referencing wm-dink-01, 3 sha-mismatch/tamper, 4 nonexistent-media/dangling references, 1 duplicate id)
method.harness: datasets/experiments/wave-f/f24-attack-harness.py (regression test; exit 1 if the f24 audit misses any attack)
method.groupingNote: no model evaluation performed; this workstream tests audit tooling, so source/session grouping does not apply

e24Baseline.note: pre-existing issues on the clean tree, identical for e24 and f24 baselines; all attack detection is measured as NEW issues relative to this baseline

e24Misses.gap: e24 has no append-only check: silently editing an existing stroke-gold label (contactMs 34689->34500) raises no issue
deleting an existing stroke-gold record raises no issue (counts are reported, not contract-checked)
rewriting a phase timestamp inside an existing bundle annotation without bumping revision passes all e24 schema checks
e24's held-out check for stroke-gold keys on the `bundle` field, but every committed label uses `caseId`; a new label with caseId wm-dink-01 is invisible to it
event-bounds-qa-wave-c is absent from e24's gold-collection held-out checks, and its sidecar check passes because wm-dink-01 is a real bundle dir; a new QA record labeling wm-dink-01 raises no issue
a stroke-gold label whose caseId references a nonexistent bundle is missed for the same bundle-vs-caseId key reason

fixes.tooling: datasets/experiments/wave-f/f24-provenance-audit.py — versioned extension of e24 (runs e24+d2-09 unchanged as modules, never rewrites their artifacts), adding: (1) append-only ledger verification over 14 label/gold collections and 76 bundle annotation files against datasets/experiments/wave-f/f24-label-ledger.json (record-level canonical-JSON sha256 multisets; annotation files may change bytes only with a strictly increased revision); (2) held-out contamination scan over unledgered additions in any protected collection (substring match on held-out case ids, covering caseId/bundle/any field); (3) stroke-gold caseId -> bundle-dir dangling-reference check
fixes.ledger: datasets/experiments/wave-f/f24-label-ledger.json generated by f24-label-ledger.py from the clean tree at baseCommit; regeneration is an integrator action after reviewing surfaced unledgered additions
fixes.contractNote: e24/d2-09 were not softened or modified; f24 is additive (new severities: append_only_violation, dangling_reference, plus held_out_violation coverage extension). Pre-existing wm-dink-01 QA verdicts in event-bounds-qa-wave-c (explicitly marked HELD-OUT observation-only, reviewed in Wave C) are ledgered and therefore not re-flagged; only NEW held-out-referencing records are violations.

knownNonMissesByDesign: corpus recordings media absence is not flagged (media is gitignored by design; d2-09 records recordingsMediaMissingOnDisk as a count) — a corpus record pointing at nonexistent media is instead caught via its unregistered sourceId (A13) or as an unledgered addition surfaced for review

an attacker who edits an annotation AND bumps revision passes the ledger contract by design: revision bumps are the documented legit relabel workflow and remain auditable in git history and surfaced in the f24 report's revisedAnnotations list
regressionTest: python3 datasets/experiments/wave-f/f24-attack-harness.py (runs all 15 attacks against both audits; exits nonzero if f24 misses any); last run: e24 9/15, f24 15/15, 0 crashes
heldOutHandling: wm-dink-01/afn-vic-rally1 content never viewed; attacks only reference their ids in sandbox copies that were deleted; label-blind fresh-candidate pool untouched except registry-level fixture entries applied in sandboxes only
